sentences.en: Lincoln set out to abolish slavery in the United States.
sentences.zh: 林肯致力于废除美国的奴隶制。

sentences.en: Slavery has been abolished in most parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 世界上大部分地区已经废除了奴隶制。

sentences.en: I thought policy was abolished a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 我以为几年前就已经废除了这项政策。

senses.zh: 废除，废止,取消，革除,消灭,撤销
